items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Now you talked about your time in Paris playing with Kenny Clarke. You also played with James Moody at that time, right? [INTERVIEWEE] I don’t remember that.

ctx.x: I don’t remember Moody being there.
Mm hmm. You also recorded, this was around 1948, ’47, with Johnny Griffin’s album “Fly Mister, Fly.” Do you remember that?
